findings.title: Abundance makes delegated protection persuasive
findings.claim: The promised freedom of roaming presents a change of custody as care: Yusuf is to be released into the brothers' company, while the keeping claim carries a duty of ongoing attention that the wider evidence makes testable.

findings.reader_payoff: The leisure invitation becomes visibly double-purpose: it offers ordinary recreation and also makes the speakers' custody claim persuasive precisely because freedom is presented as protected abundance.
findings.containment: The ordinary request for Yusuf to roam and play remains intact. This finding does not prove the brothers' inner motive at this moment, and it does not turn the promise into a statement about divine or unseen guardianship.
